tokens.name: Reflection Of Self
tokens.description:
Peel back the layers  
Give the masks a break

Look inward through to bare  
Who else is in there

Is this everything?  
The essence, the unseen

Beneath the surface  
A world of dreams unfold

In the mirror’s embrace  
A scene untold

tokens.description:
In a graceful choreography, every movement becomes a silent conversation between the past and the present, dancing within the tapestry of existence.

tokens.name: Burn The Roses
tokens.description:
Whispers once vibrant now still,  
Crimson dreams in dark decay,  
Ripples dance, embers rise,  
Leaving marks along their way.

In twilight's shadow he ponders,  
Fire's dance reflects his plight,  
An envelope of silent words,  
Lost in the quiet of the night.

Red petals turn to black,  
Memories dissolve, disappear,  
Silent storms with no return,  
Mysteries we can't clear.

&

In shadows, hope ignites,  
Though roses burn, hearts find light,  
From ashes, rise unseen,  
Begin again, amidst the night.

tokens.name: Crimson Falls
tokens.description:
As all teeters..  
On life's edge.

Safety calls softly..  
The deep void tempts.

The leap is ours alone..  
We fall or forge ahead.
